title: Nominee Check
description: Stops a bank, locker or demat nomination that won't do what the holder thinks, by checking it against the 2025 bank nomination rules and SEBI's 2026 limits: shares that don't add to 100%, a fifth bank nominee (or fourth demat one) that won't count, a split on a locker that can only go in order, a demat nominee with no relationship or a minor with no date of birth, a minor with no adult to receive, the same person twice and no nominee at all, then reading back in plain words who gets what, with one-tap fixes.
